{{Quote|My father and I used to travel a lot on the ''Windrunner''. I feel closer to him here.|Bron Dooku|<ref name="AOTE2" />}}
The '''''Windrunner''''' was a balloon-lifted private airship that belonged to the [[House Dooku]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. During his reign, [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Adan Dooku|Adan]] of the House Dooku regularly traveled aboard the ''Windrunner'', accompanied by his son, [[Bron Dooku|Bron]]. In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], a [[Dooku regency conclave|regency conclave]] took place aboard the airship. In the midst of negotiations, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Rodas Borgin|Rodas]] of the [[House Borgin/Legends|House Borgin]] hired the crew of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] airship ''[[Bloodskull]]'' to [[Attack on the Windrunner|attack]] the ''Windrunner'' and kidnap the young Count Bron Dooku.<ref name="AOTE2" />
